# MCPHub

> > MCPHub is a comprehensive directory of 10,000+ Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for AI workflows, featuring certified servers, integration guides, and tools for Claude Desktop and other LLM applications.

MCPHub serves as the central discovery platform for MCP servers across diverse domains including blockchain, cryptocurrency, databases, developer tools, and content generation. The platform provides quality evaluations, API schemas, integration documentation, and community feedback for servers built in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, and Go.

## Key Topics

- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Claude Desktop
- MCP Server Directory
- API Documentation
- Python
- TypeScript
- Node.js
- Blockchain & Smart Contracts
- Cryptocurrency
- Database Integration
- Developer Tools
- Safe Wallet
- Finance & Trading
- Content Generation
- LLM Integration
